user_message: I typed the wrong password too many times yesterday and now every cloud app says my account is locked.
expected_response: Your account looks locked. Wait 15 minutes, try signing in once with the correct password, and let us know the exact sign-in error if it still fails.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact lockout or sign-in error message.
Wait 15 minutes and try one sign-in with the correct password.
Verify the account is not locked in the standard support directory tool.
Escalate for manual unlock if the account remains blocked.

user_message: My Android mail app keeps asking for updated credentials after my password expired overnight.
expected_response: Please reset your password through the approved reset page, then sign out and back in to affected apps after a short wait for sync.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the password is expired or recently changed.
Reset the password in the approved self-service portal.
Sign out of affected apps and wait a few minutes for credential sync.
Sign back in and escalate if the new password is still rejected.

user_message: I can receive mail on my phone, but Outlook on my desktop refuses to send any new messages.
expected_response: Check Outlook connection status, confirm the mailbox is not full, and test sending a simple message without attachments.
resolution_steps: Verify Outlook shows connected status and the device has internet access.
Check whether the mailbox is full or the message has a large attachment.
Restart Outlook and send a short test email without attachments.
Escalate to the messaging team if mail stays stuck in Outbox.

user_message: I can open the VPN client on iPhone, but after approval it immediately returns to the sign-in screen.
expected_response: Confirm your password and MFA approval, then retry the VPN connection after restarting the client.
resolution_steps: Confirm the exact VPN authentication error message.
Verify the username, password, and MFA approval are correct.
Restart the VPN client and retry the connection.
Escalate to the network team if authentication still fails.

user_message: I reconnected to the network today and now the nearest printer appears offline in my queue.
expected_response: Check that the correct printer is selected, clear any stuck jobs, and confirm the device shows online before printing again.
resolution_steps: Confirm the printer name and whether others can print to it.
Clear stuck jobs from the print queue.
Verify the printer is online and selected correctly.
Escalate to desktop support if the printer remains offline.

user_message: My laptop says connected to Wi-Fi but I cannot open anything until I disconnect and reconnect again.
expected_response: Reconnect to the approved Wi-Fi network, forget the saved profile if needed, and test the connection again.
resolution_steps: Confirm the device can see the correct corporate SSID.
Toggle Wi-Fi off and on, then reconnect to the approved network.
Forget the saved network profile and reconnect if the problem continues.
Escalate with the user location if the device still cannot connect.

user_message: Several bookmarks return address not found on my desktop, but the sites work for my teammate.
expected_response: This looks like a DNS issue. Restart the network connection, test another internal site, and retry after reconnecting to the correct network or VPN.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether only hostnames fail while IP-based access still works.
Restart the network adapter or reconnect the device to the network.
Test another internal hostname or reconnect to VPN if remote.
Escalate to network operations if DNS resolution still fails.

user_message: I need the approved desktop app for training today, but it refuses to start on my Windows 11 machine.
expected_response: Restart the device, try opening the app again, and note any error text so support can determine whether the problem is local or application-specific.
resolution_steps: Confirm the application name and any visible launch error.
Close the app fully and restart the device.
Retry the app from the standard shortcut or approved install path.
Escalate with the exact error if the app still will not open.

user_message: The laptop recognizes the charger for a second and then switches back to battery mode.
expected_response: Reconnect the charger firmly, test another outlet if possible, and check whether the charging indicator comes on.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the issue occurs with the charger, outlet, or dock.
Reconnect the power adapter and test another outlet if available.
Check for charging indicators or battery status changes.
Escalate for hardware assessment if the laptop still does not charge.

user_message: The authenticator app says it is ready, but I am not receiving any verification requests at sign-in.
expected_response: Check network connectivity on the phone, open the authenticator app directly, and confirm the correct work account is still registered.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the user expects a push notification or an app-generated code.
Check the phone has internet access and automatic time enabled.
Open the authenticator app and confirm the work account is present.
Escalate for MFA reset if approvals or codes still do not arrive.

user_message: My external monitor is connected to the laptop dock, but the screen is not detected at all.
expected_response: Reconnect the monitor cable, confirm the correct input source is selected, and run display detection again.
resolution_steps: Confirm the monitor is powered on and connected correctly.
Reseat the video cable and verify the monitor input source.
Use display settings to detect the monitor again.
Escalate if the external display is still not detected.

user_message: A browser pop-up says the site data is corrupted, and our internal dashboard will not finish loading.
expected_response: Clear the affected site data, reopen the browser, and test the page again to remove corrupted local cache.
resolution_steps: Confirm the issue affects one dashboard or site only.
Test the site in a private window.
Clear cached data for the affected site and restart the browser.
Escalate if the page still fails after cache cleanup.
